Author: jFray
Name: EchoMix
Description: An interactive DJ deck with live mixing tools, custom playlists, and a synced listener mode with an audio visualizer.
Punchline: Spin tracks and let the party sync in.
Changelog: Added Follow to DJ profiles - get a brief on-screen notification with a one-click Join button the moment a followed DJ starts a public show (position configurable in Settings). Added a genre filter to the DJ List and Live Shows grids. Added Auto-DJ, an opt-in toggle that automatically fades into the other deck as the current track nears its end. Redesigned the DJ List and DJ Profile pages with a more modern look, and added a separate Name Color option for DJ profiles.
